title: GL-21 — ElastiCache tradeoffs
stopChargesPanel: Delete the cache cluster, wait until it is deleted, then delete the cache subnet group; ElastiCache is hourly.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on ElastiCache; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Accept cost risk
bullets: In the lab card, open the cost-risk box and type `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` exactly as shown.
Success: the UI records your confirmation before any hourly resource is created.
Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.

steps.title: Cache subnet group
bullets: Run `$VpcId = aws ec2 describe-vpcs --filters Name=isDefault,Values=true --query "Vpcs[0].VpcId" --output text`.
Run `$SubnetIds = (aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=$VpcId --query "Subnets[0:2].SubnetId" --output text) -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ }`.
Run `aws elasticache create-cache-subnet-group --cache-subnet-group-name workbook-gl21 --cache-subnet-group-description gl21 --subnet-ids $SubnetIds`.
Success: subnet group is available.

steps.title: Create cluster
bullets: Run `aws elasticache create-cache-cluster --cache-cluster-id workbook-gl21 --engine redis --cache-node-type cache.t3.micro --num-cache-nodes 1 --cache-subnet-group-name workbook-gl21 --tags Key=LabId,Value=gl-21 Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab`.
Run `aws elasticache wait cache-cluster-available --cache-cluster-id workbook-gl21`.
Success: CacheClusterStatus is available.

steps.title: Describe cluster
bullets: Run `aws elasticache describe-cache-clusters --cache-cluster-id workbook-gl21 --show-cache-node-info`.
Success: endpoint is returned.

steps.title: Delete cluster
bullets: Run `aws elasticache delete-cache-cluster --cache-cluster-id workbook-gl21`.
Run `aws elasticache wait cache-cluster-deleted --cache-cluster-id workbook-gl21`.
Success: cluster deleted.

steps.title: Delete subnet group
bullets: Run `aws elasticache delete-cache-subnet-group --cache-subnet-group-name workbook-gl21`.
Success: subnet group gone.

steps.title: Hourly reminder
bullets: Cache nodes bill hourly while available.
Success: cluster deleted this session.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Confirm you typed `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` in the card before any hourly create.
Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: ElastiCache cluster (wait until deleted), subnet group
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-21` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-21 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-21 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-21. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Smallest ElastiCache Redis node, describe, delete same day.
